subject: rstan not using chain_id if auto_write=TRUE?

messages.author: 6b3dfa6c2646a8c1
messages.subject: rstan not using chain_id if auto_write=TRUE?
parts:
Hello Stan team,

A very minor possible bug report. I've just noticed that rstan does not appear to use the chain_id argument if auto_write=TRUE. Here is example code and pasted below is console output.

library(rstan)

rstan_options(auto_write=FALSE)
stan(model_code="parameters { real x; } model { x ~ normal(0, 1); }", chain_id=5:8)  # uses chain_id 5:8

rstan_options(auto_write=TRUE)
options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())
stan(model_code="parameters { real x; } model { x ~ normal(0, 1); }", chain_id=5:8)  # uses chain_id 1:4

sessionInfo()


I'm using rstan 2.9.0-3 in R 3.2.4 on Mac OS 10.11.4:

Thanks. Ben opened an issue, so it should get fixed:

https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/issues/294

- Bob
